question: Average of first 'N' odd natural numbers is 21. What is the value of 'N'?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Property: Average of first N odd natural numbers is always equal to N.

Given: Average of first N odd numbers = 21.

Comparing with the property: N = 21.

**∴ The correct answer is 21.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Average of first N odd natural numbers = 21.

**Formula Used:** Sum of first N odd natural numbers = N² | Average = Sum ÷ N

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3d83e263042e6ce840418586bb9fc71b276b673ac42a5be665e036c04fa198da.png] 

⇒ The first N odd numbers are: 1, 3, 5, ..., (2N − 1).

⇒ Sum of first N odd numbers = 1 + 3 + 5 + ... + (2N − 1) = N².

⇒ Average = Total Sum ÷ Total Terms

⇒ Average = N² ÷ N = N.

⇒ Since Given Average = 21,

⇒ N = 21.

**∴ The correct answer is 21.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average of first N natural numbers

The sum of first N natural numbers is N(N + 1) ÷ 2, so the average is (N + 1) ÷ 2.

Average of first N even natural numbers

The sum of first N even natural numbers is N(N + 1), so the average is (N + 1).

Sum of squares of first N natural numbers

The formula for the sum of squares is [N(N + 1)(2N + 1)] ÷ 6.
